about: Semantic assembly model of Reliable Tech Park, B Wing, Airoli - 6th floor, Offices 603 & 604 (Altruist). Generated by scripts/infer.py from the drawing evidence (pieces.json) and rules.json. Plan metres from the drawing origin; z from this floor's finished floor. Every attribute: {value, source: cad|designer|client|default, confidence 0-1}.
